messages:
maya: quick ping — opened PR #4823 to add a VPC egress route for the gpu-subnet so outbound traffic hits the new NATGW. hoping someone can give this a quick look during today's merge window: https://github.com/redwood/pr/4823

maya: short description + plan attached in PR, changes are limited to one `aws_route` and an assoc update. no instance replacements expected.

tomas: taking a look now, will run a plan in the canary account and report back.

ops-bot: CI: terraform fmt ✅, terraform validate ✅, terragrunt plan completed (canary). Plan shows: + aws_route.gpu_egress -> 1 add

liam: quick question — does this rely on NATGW creation ordering? plan looks fine but if the NATGW is replacing we could transiently blackhole egress. can we guard with an explicit dependency?

maya: good call. current snippet: `resource "aws_route" "gpu_egress" { gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.gpu.id route_table_id = aws_route_table.gpu_rt.id destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0" }`

liam: suggestion: add `depends_on = [aws_nat_gateway.gpu]` to the route so TF doesn't try to attach before the gateway is fully ready. tiny change, pinging for re-run.

tomas: agree with liam. also will run an apply in canary if maya pushes the change.

maya: pushed patch with depends_on, rebased against main.

ops-bot: CI: terraform fmt ✅, terraform validate ✅, terragrunt plan (canary) shows no replacements and only + aws_route.gpu_egress as expected.

devops-sme: quick FYI — if this lands during the afternoon window we might see brief metrics blips; recommend scheduling at low-traffic 30m slot. otherwise LGTM from infra perspective.

liam: reviewed the diff, tests, and canary output. approvable after devops-sme sign-off. :thumbsup:

tomas: second approval from me as well, will hold for devops-sme final note.

devops-sme: ok I checked the canary logs, NATGW stabilized during apply, no errors. approving now.

maya: thanks everyone — merging in ~20m unless anyone calls a blocker.

tomas: noted, will watch metrics post-merge and rollback plan ready.

maya: merging now. will post a follow-up if anything odd shows up. :rocket:
